findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_customer · Public sink: get_customer, update_customer, delete_customer · Destructive: delete_page, delete_product, delete_customer, delete_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_customer · Public sink: get_customer, update_customer, delete_customer · Destructive: delete_page, delete_product, delete_customer, delete_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
